channel.title: MCP Monitor Daily Report
channel.description: Daily monitoring of Model Context Protocol mentions

item.title: GitHub - invertedmushroom/codified-context-harness: 3-tier Codified Context meta-harness for Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Antigravity, DSH & ZCode: hook routing, MCP cold memory, and static/Pareto evals. · GitHub
item.description: Turns out your coding agent needs a filing cabinet, a bouncer, and a report card, and this repo hands you all three, MCP servers included.

item.title: GitHub - cpldxx/the-sovereign: A research lab that never stops: give it a topic, it researches every night, keeps each fact with its source in a knowledge graph, and proves what it learned on an exam. Self-hosted, on local models or Claude. · GitHub
item.description: A lab that studies a topic while you sleep, grades itself on a quiz it wrote from sources it was never allowed to read, and keeps its homework tidy in a graph.

item.title: MCP server authentication: is your remote MCP server public? Test tools/list with curl · Abbi Labs
item.description: Your MCP server is probably open to the internet, and /mcp is the first URL anyone will guess. A two-minute curl test will tell you whether strangers can see your tools.

item.title: Best PDF and documents MCP servers (November 2026) · tested every night
item.description: A leaderboard for PDF servers that asks models to read, parse and create documents, scored every night by someone who clearly enjoys spreadsheets more than sleep.

item.title: GitHub - soodhere/saktum-check: Test your MCP server in one command: OWASP MCP Top 10, OAuth sign-in, conformance, agent experience and context cost. Grade, fixes, signed result. · GitHub
item.description: Your MCP server walks into a grader, and the grader has opinions about its AWS keys and stack traces. Helpfully, it also suggests fixes.

item.title: GitHub - relaticle/relaticle: Open-source CRM your AI agents can read and update: companies, people, opportunities, tasks and notes. REST API, self-hosted or cloud. · GitHub
item.description: Your sales pipeline now has an MCP server, so your AI assistant can finally update the CRM without you lifting a finger. Assuming you still have a list of companies to sell to.

item.title: GitHub - chempane/chempane: chempane (formerly chemdraw-mcp): chemistry panel for Claude Desktop (MCP server). Ask for a molecule, get a drawing you can turn, click and export. Structures, 3D models, mechanisms and Anki cards drawn locally with RDKit, plus spectra and lab plots; proteins from the PDB or AlphaFold. Unofficial, not affiliated with Revvity. · GitHub
item.description: Ask Claude for caffeine and get a rotatable 3D molecule instead of a wall of text. Chemistry homework just got a lot more pleasant.

item.title: GitHub - thoufeeque22/zeroburn: Zero-waste hybrid AI coding-agent orchestrator: cut Claude/Gemini quota burn by 80% with 0-token static checks, local Ollama diff review, code-graph pre-fetching & 1-line test receipts. · GitHub
item.description: Someone decided Claude's quota was too precious to waste on line counts, so the checks now run in Python and a local model gets the diff review. Your rate limit will thank you.

item.title: BOTERNITY log, 2026-11-21
item.description: A developer log of one busy day, where a server grew from a handful of endpoints to 29 tools and learned to speak Streamable HTTP without asking for a login. The registry listing is the grown-up touch

item.title: GitHub - stn1slv/teamscache: CLI and read-only MCP server for the local Microsoft Teams v2 message cache. No Graph API, no network. · GitHub
item.description: Teams keeps your recent chats on disk whether your tenant admin likes it or not. This tool reads them and hands them to your AI assistant, no OAuth dance required.

item.title: 43 MCP servers on one laptop. 9 are in no settings file. · RegulAI
item.description: Your laptop has forty-three MCP servers and a settings file that admits to thirty-four. The other nine are hiding in plugins, extensions and places nobody thought to check.

item.title: Shipping one MCP server into two very different rulebooks - PaPoo
item.description: Turns out the secret sauce behind impressive AI agents is less wizardry and more plumbing, the boring kind that finds the right runbook before anyone panics.
